Name: Dark Sienna and Porcelain Tools Recolor
Author: dunnisimtrouble
Description:
This is a tool recolor content pack that makes the wood of tools a darker brown and the tips white and creamy.
[size=5]
[b]Tools Available[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Watering Can
[*]Axes
[*]Pickaxes
[*]Hoes
[*]Scythe (not golden)
[/list][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
5. Launch your game and enjoy!


Leave any suggestions you may have! Thank you
